request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Redraw only the legs. The machine is a tripod with exactly three long legs, never four: one thick leg down and out to the left, one straight down in the middle, one down and out to the right, with wide empty gaps between them; each leg dark gunmetal with a round chrome knee and a chunky chrome foot, as now. Keep the chrome hood, the magenta eye lens, the body lights, the heat-ray arm, the height, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
